messages:
claire: quick thread — we need a provenance story for quant profiles. ops and security want an auditable way to know which profile produced which outputs.
omar: agreed. current profile_version is not enough; we need immutability and a signature.
linh: proposal: profile artifacts get a content-hash and a signing key (kms-sig). store `profile_id` = sha256 + short tag, and emit `X-Precision-Profile: pid-<short>` header on responses.
marta: that helps for tracing. also we should persist the exact profile bundle (schema, multipliers, risk_tags) to the profile registry so replays are exact.
security-bot: recommendation: sign with customer-scoped key for private deployments, org-key for hosted. rotation policy must be recorded.
omar: we should include an optional `signed_by` field and `signature_ts` in metadata. add API to fetch signed bundles for a trace_id.
linh: replay infra idea: given a trace_id + profile_id, replay the exact RPC sequence against offline runtime to compute delta_report. store replay artifacts for 14 days.
claire: offline replays are huge for large tenants. suggestion: keep a lightweight fingerprint (top-k tokens + embedding snapshot) for quick diffs and run full replay on demand.
ops-bot: note: storing full bundles increases storage by ~45% per profile. estimate extra S3 cost.
marta: tradeoffs: full-bundle storage buys deterministic audits; lightweight snapshot is cheaper but not fully reproducible. we need both: snapshot for quick triage, full-bundle on-demand.
omar: another operational need: profile compatibility matrix. when we update default profiles, compute compatibility_score against current stable profiles and surface breaking diffs.
linh: implement CI job that, on profile push, runs a battery of small prompts and reports token-delta, top-k overlap, and embedding drift. store results under profile metadata.
claire: API surface suggestion: GET /profiles/{id}/audit -> returns [signed_bundle_url, compatibility_report_url, sample_snapshot_url]. keep URLs time-limited.
security-bot: add ACLs: only authorized users and SRE can fetch signed private bundles. audit logs mandatory.
omar: runtime header plan: responses include `X-Precision-Profile`, `X-Precision-Trace`, and `X-Profile-Signature` (short sig). users can provide trace_id to request replays.
marta: rollout plan: 1) profile-hash + registry + minimal snapshot (2 weeks) 2) signing + ACLs for private 3) replay endpoint + full-bundle retention (on-demand export) 4) CI compatibility checks 5) UI in console
claire: timeline realistic? 
linh: prototype registry + hash in 2 weeks. signing + ACLs another 2. replay infra will take longer (4w).
ops-bot: queued job: infra/profile-registry/1819990000 -> pending
omar: action items: @linh build registry + hash, @claire design API and snapshot format, @marta draft rollout notes, @omar add compatibility CI job.
marta: one more: let's keep profile bundle size bounded (<256kb) by moving large arrays to compressed storage and only pushing multipliers + metadata in main registry. full tensors live in archive blobstore.
claire: agreed. also recommend a `trust_level` + `provenance` fields so UI can show "created-by: auto-calib-v2" vs "uploaded-by: tenant".
linh: small implementation note: compute-hash should be content-stable (canonical JSON) to avoid churn.
marta: closing — i'll update the RFC with these decisions and add the audit checklist. :wave:
